name: Late or superseded async reply applied (no or weak request/generation check)
rule: R1 ticket-gated replies; AppCx::spawn only in the shell, its then-closure only forwards to apply; per-thread attach epoch at ingress

name: Per-thread model state lost or leaked on thread switch (one widget rebuilt by replay)
rule: R2 per-thread data only in ThreadModel; switch round-trip property test

name: Per-thread widget-owned state (draft, kill buffer) lost or carried over on switch
rule: R2 per-thread subtrees keyed by ThreadId (one helper); drafts/queues/kill buffer placed by scope; switch round-trip test

name: Event, reply or effect routed to the wrong thread/backend (active thread used instead of origin)
rule: R3 thread-scoped apply and effects; (ThreadId, id) keys; user intents carry target ThreadId

name: Same item rendered twice or split (append-only history, not keyed by item id)
rule: R4 transcript keyed by (TurnId, ItemId) with upsert; one protocol projection

name: Backend emits distinct items with the same content
rule: (backend semantics)

name: Lifecycle-scoped transient state not cleared on every end path (turn complete/interrupt/fail)
rule: R5 transient state inside the lifecycle enum variant; end-path matrix test (complete/interrupt/fail) for misplaced fields

name: Data dropped at a lifecycle end before it was flushed
rule: R5 end transition consumes the variant by value; transition test

name: UI component keeps its own copy of model state, synced by setters/refresh calls
rule: R14 app data never in rtwk local state: clippy disallowed_types on Obs/hook state outside an allowlist

name: Second source of truth read outside the model (file on disk, config default)
rule: R12 IO only in effects; apply/view have no IO; disallowed-methods lint

name: Remote data not re-fetched when it should be (refresh policy)
rule: R6 Remote<T> with fetched-at/generation (makes age visible, policy stays)

name: Derived value cached by hand in state for non-view consumers
rule: R7 derived values are fns on the model; any cache checked by a consistency assertion after every event in tests

name: Display flag set imperatively instead of derived (status indicator, task_running conflated)
rule: R7 derived values as fns, consistency assertion after every event in tests; R8 lifecycle enum

name: Gating predicate with wrong semantics (what blocks the input queue)
rule: R8 lifecycle enum + predicates as fns; lifecycle x intent table test

name: One bool for two outcomes
rule: R8 outcomes as enums (convention for new code)

name: Entity needed from a notification that may arrive after the response
rule: R9 create/upsert from whichever arrives first; event-permutation property test

name: Local state assumed ahead of the backend (optimistic trim, cached turn id, missed reconcile)
rule: R9 pending ops as states, mutate on confirmation; event-permutation property test

name: User input interleaved with a backend transition (submit during stream, before session ready)
rule: R10 shared-state intents are values in the same ordered stream; permutation test

name: View state stale against changed data (index selection, loading shown as empty, clock in view)
rule: R11 lists on rtwk SelectionList<K> (keyed); Remote<T> Loading/Loaded/Failed; clock only as model input (disallowed_methods Instant::now in views)

name: Selection/order semantics after data changes (neighbour selection, stable ordering)
rule: (product rule; list tests)

name: Blocking work on the event path / concurrent writers
rule: R12 apply has no IO; effects via shell spawn; responsiveness gate

name: Wrong identifier used or id not unique in its scope
rule: R13 newtype per id kind; composite keys where ids are scoped

name: Feature logic error in a state transition (not a state-mechanism class)
rule: (feature tests)

name: Backend, persistence or protocol (not TUI state)
rule: n/a

name: Layout, text, style or input layer (other bug-classes.md classes)
rule: n/a
